headline: Rezoning of FedEx Freight's 56 Godsoe Road recommended to City Council; land development permit granted for 2,000-square-foot cold-storage building at 32 Thatcher Street.
summary: The 56 Godsoe Road site covers approximately 4.73 acres, and FedEx Freight, Incorporated is the applicant and owner; the City Council makes the final zoning decision. At 32 Thatcher Street, Bangor Lewiston Property LLC, which does business as The Granite Group, plans to add a cold-storage building to its outdoor storage site, with no heat, water, or sewer. A city status update said text review of the land development code should be done by mid-December, with the goal of finishing the first review early next year. Members also adopted findings for 1187 Union Street.
decisions: Recommended that the City Council approve the zone change for 56 Godsoe Road from I&S to UID, 6-0.
Accepted the land development permit application for 32 Thatcher Street as complete, 6-0.
Granted the land development permit for a 2,000-square-foot cold-storage building at 32 Thatcher Street, 6-0.
discussion: Godsoe Road rezoning: The applicant's attorney said the change fits the 2022 Comprehensive Plan's industrial area near I-95. The attorney also noted that the City Council rezoned nearby 69 Perry Road to UID by ordinance this past November 2025.

Thatcher Street buffer questions: Board members asked about a house reached by a narrow strip near 27 Olive Street. City staff said the code's buffer rule applies to residential zones, not to residential uses.
Reduced attendance: Six members were present, so applicants could postpone to a later meeting with seven. The Thatcher Street applicant chose to proceed, and four votes were needed to pass.

Land development code update: A status update said text review should be done by mid-December, with zoning map review to follow. An airport overlay district and historic view-shed mapping could take longer, with the goal of finishing early next year.
